messages:
Alice Ops: getting hit with a big traffic burst to hosted API in us-central1, GPU pools are maxed and autoscaler isn't adding nodes :grimacing:
Brian SRE: seeing the same alerts. pending_pods is spiking but node provisioning lag is >3m. looks like scale-up lag + thrash from rapid churn
Marta Observability: Grafana: https://grafana.corp/r/redwood/d/GPUpool?orgId=1
Marta Observability: promql snapshot: `sum(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending",job="kube-state-metrics"}) by (node)` -> huge jump at 17:02
Dani Eng: autoscaler logs show repeated scale-down/surge events -> bad signal from our scheduling probe. possibly the pod spec requests fluctuate (cpu vs gpu)
Carla Platform: we should stop the aggressive downscaler to avoid thrash. moving to manual scaling while we stabilize :+1:
Brian SRE: I can manual-scale GPU pool in us-central1 to +8 nodes. running: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-gpu-us-central1 --size 18`
DeployBot: deploy pipeline: manual instance resize initiated by @Brian SRE at 1755001402
Alice Ops: routing change proposed: shift 40% traffic to us-east1 to relieve pressure. Canary weight change in traffic-router: `route set --service inference --region us-central1 --weight 60`
Dani Eng: also disabling cluster-autoscaler downscale: update helm values, set `downscaleEnabled: false` for us-central1 pool
Carla Platform: note on cost — this will spike infra spend short-term but keeps latency SLOs. logged in incident ticket #INC-8342
Marta Observability: added alert threshold adjustments to avoid signal oscillation. changed the pending_pods alert to 5m sustained window
Brian SRE: after manual scale and routing shift we see queue drop and GPU utilization settling. will watch for 10m then re-enable autoscaler with higher stabilization window
Alice Ops: thanks team. assigning follow-ups: @Dani add kube pod request validation to CI, @Carla plan autoscaler policy tweak, @Brian monitor for 30m. closing this thread when stable :white_check_mark:
